name: Aircraft Radar

descriptions.en_US: Live aircraft around a point you choose, on one key or a 2x2 block of keys. Nearest aircraft are colored and listed, over a dim world map outline. Data comes from community ADS-B (and MLAT) receivers via api.adsb.lol.
